title: Guided reading: light and life
subtitle: Put the first patterns together in a short controlled text.
overview: Read slowly: identify articles, finite verbs, and the genitive phrase before translating.
This is controlled Koine-style practice, not a quotation to treat as a critical text.

items.grc: ὁ θεὸς δίδωσιν τὸ φῶς τῆς ζωῆς.
items.en: God gives the light of life.

items.grc: οἱ μαθηταὶ ἀκούουσιν τὸν λόγον τοῦ κυρίου.
items.en: The disciples hear the word of the Lord.

items.grc: ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστὶν ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ.
items.en: The love of God is in the world.
